parameters.query: SELECT c.id as client_id, c.client_code, c.company_name, c.plan_type, c.contact_email, c.max_contacts, c.max_keywords, c.max_emails_per_month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE client_id = c.id) as contact_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracked_keywords WHERE client_id = c.id AND is_active = true) as keyword_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE client_id = c.id AND action LIKE '%email_sent%' AND created_at > date_trunc('month', NOW())) as emails_this_month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_execution_stats WHERE client_id = c.id AND status = 'error' AND started_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') as errors_24h, (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM audit_logs WHERE client_id = c.id) as last_activity FROM clients c WHERE c.status = 'active' ORDER BY c.id
